covers: The V30's own vectors, the five the core names; INT n and INT3 take a number the program gives

entries.name: divide error
entries.description: Where a divide by zero or a quotient that does not fit goes.
entries.behaviour: The divide instructions call nec_interrupt(NEC_DIVIDE_VECTOR, BRK) for a zero divisor (after clearing the carry and overflow values) or a quotient the destination cannot hold (the DIVUB, DIVB macros and their word forms). nec_interrupt pushes the flags, clears TF and IF, reads the new IP from linear address 4n and PS from 4n+2, pushes the old PS and IP, and jumps.

entries.name: single-step trap
entries.description: Where POPF goes when it leaves the trap flag set.
entries.behaviour: Only nec_trap raises it: it runs one more instruction, then calls nec_interrupt(NEC_TRAP_VECTOR, BRK), and the only caller is POPF (0x9D) with TF set. The core does not check TF between other instructions. nec_interrupt pushes the flags, clears TF and IF, reads the new IP from linear address 4n and PS from 4n+2, pushes the old PS and IP, and jumps.

entries.name: NMI
entries.behaviour: external_int calls nec_interrupt(NEC_NMI_VECTOR, NMI_IRQ) when the NMI line was raised (set_nmi_line, any state but clear), whatever the IF flag. nec_interrupt pushes the flags, clears TF and IF, reads the new IP from linear address 4n and PS from 4n+2, pushes the old PS and IP, and jumps.

entries.name: overflow
entries.description: Where INTO goes when the overflow flag is set.
entries.behaviour: INTO (0xCE) calls nec_interrupt(NEC_BRKV_VECTOR, BRK) when OF is set and costs 3 cycles otherwise. nec_interrupt pushes the flags, clears TF and IF, reads the new IP from linear address 4n and PS from 4n+2, pushes the old PS and IP, and jumps.

entries.name: bound check
entries.description: Where CHKIND goes when its register is out of bounds.
entries.behaviour: CHKIND (0x62) reads a low and a high word from its memory operand and calls nec_interrupt(NEC_CHKIND_VECTOR, BRK) when the register is below the first or above the second. nec_interrupt pushes the flags, clears TF and IF, reads the new IP from linear address 4n and PS from 4n+2, pushes the old PS and IP, and jumps.
